cases.description: Bounded temporal-logic fixture covering safety, bounded response, absence, ordering, and deadline violations.

findings.message: backup-success-safety: safety condition failed for metric 'backup.pg_dump.success'
findings.remediation: Keep every matched event inside the declared temporal invariant.

findings.message: request-failure-alert-response: no response 'request.alerted' within 1000ms after trigger 'request.failed'
findings.remediation: Emit the required response event inside the bounded response window after each trigger.

findings.message: no-raw-secret-logs: forbidden event log 'debug.raw_secret_preview' was observed
findings.remediation: Do not emit the forbidden event in traces covered by this absence property.

findings.message: deploy-start-before-finish: 'deploy.finished' occurred without prior 'deploy.started'
findings.remediation: Emit telemetry in the order required by the temporal property or sequence.

findings.message: restore-deadline: 'incident.restored' missed 5000ms deadline by 1001.000ms
findings.remediation: Emit the deadline-bound event before the declared time budget expires.
